name: grype
title: Grype
description: Anchore Grype vulnerability scanner for container images, filesystems, and SBOMs. GRYPE_TARGET is the image name (e.g. alpine:3.10), a directory, or a path to an SBOM. GRYPE_FAIL_ON sets the severity threshold above which the scan is marked failed — valid values: negligible | low | medium | high | critical. GRYPE_SCOPE controls layer coverage — valid values: squashed (default, scans the merged image) | all-layers (scans every layer separately). GRYPE_ONLY_FIXED=true hides vulnerabilities that have no upstream fix.
